patterns.name: Capability advertised without an operational path
patterns.example: description claimed improvement but body did not provide the workflow
patterns.generalFixRule: Supply a bounded operational path for each advertised capability, or narrow the description
patterns.fix: Observe friction; fix scope/acceptance; delegate author/opposite review/repair; parent acceptance; integrate after shutdown
patterns.requirementsAddressed: Iteration 0 description/body consistency (static, not a behavioral clear round)

patterns.name: Fresh session inside an inherited instruction tree
patterns.example: Fresh OpenCode sessions were underneath Runeweave; --pure did not suppress ancestor AGENTS loading, confounding no-git deviations
patterns.generalFixRule: Verify automatic instruction sources and launch isolated sessions outside the project with supported suppression flags; new session IDs alone are insufficient
patterns.fix: Clean baseline rerun outside Runeweave with three verified instruction-suppression flags; fixed scenarios unchanged
patterns.requirementsAddressed: Empirical blank-slate invocation contract, not a new checklist requirement

patterns.name: Search and status labels without exact result semantics
patterns.example: Concept-id query returned empty; constant revalidation flag and peerExport completion were misread
patterns.generalFixRule: Document searchable fields, exact keys, bounds and each result annotation separately from validation/adoption state
patterns.fix: Document search fields, caps, constant annotations and separate parent/peer artifacts; four static-review corrections retained.

patterns.name: Lifecycle stage names without artifact handoff mapping
patterns.example: Rereview has no own verb; remainingChecks locations and continuation directory wording required interpretation; B4 reported a real draft value without identifying its source artifact
patterns.generalFixRule: Map each lifecycle stage to exact input/output identities and preserve independent author/reviewer histories
patterns.fix: Operation selection first; complete review/revise/review file handoff; distinct remaining-check and receipt sources; same-session correction creates new immutable-history-linked run.

patterns.name: Detailed contract narrowed but summaries remain universal
patterns.example: Concept-ID incidental matches, already reviewed records, and review-list bounds were overgeneralized; old basicflow contradicted new retrieval guidance
patterns.generalFixRule: Check summaries and examples against counterexamples as well as the detailed field contract; agreement does not replace parent consistency checks
patterns.fix: Same author/reviewer repaired H1 output paths, H2 prerequisite ordering and Node/cwd exemption, H3 generated versus issue/reference IDs, H4 arbitrary review round; parent accepted v5 receipt clarification.

patterns.name: Prerequisites applied before selecting the requested operation
patterns.example: A invoked a prohibited Git version probe although registration did not need snapshot provenance
patterns.generalFixRule: Choose the operation first, then apply only needed prerequisites within the task command restrictions
patterns.fix: Operation selection first; complete review/revise/review file handoff; distinct remaining-check and receipt sources; same-session correction creates new immutable-history-linked run.
patterns.outcome: Standalone writer workflow passes. Version probes still occurred; do not claim the documentation eliminated them. Parent checked actual effects and retained literal deviations under user intent.

patterns.name: Concurrent CLI initialization contends on shared session storage
patterns.example: Two simultaneous OpenCode launches exited before session creation with database is locked; zero events and unchanged fixture bytes.
patterns.generalFixRule: Separate transport startup failures from instruction execution and preserve them; stagger shared CLI initialization while retaining fresh sessions and overlapping independent work.
patterns.fix: Five-second startup stagger authorized after byte/session checks; failed outputs preserved; no model or global configuration substitution.
patterns.limits: Observed startup recovery only; not a universal concurrency guarantee. No session or fixture mutation occurred before failed launches.

interpretation: Raw reflections include documented limitations, scenario questions and hypothetical runtime features. Parent classifies actionable target defects using fixed requirements and actual evidence; every reflection is not automatically a missing instruction.
